content.title: Damon Stoudamire & Bonzi Wells Reflect On "Jail Blazers" Era In Early 2000s
content.text: Damon Stoudamire & Bonzi Wells sit down to explain how they felt about being a part of the Portland "Jail Blazers" in the early 2000s. Bonzi wore it as a badge of honor, while Damon found it to be disrespectful. A new documentary just released on Netflix named "Untold: Jail Blazers" detailing EVERYTHING you could ever want about this Portland Trail Blazers team.
